APP_ORIGIN.description: Your deployed Worker HTTPS origin, without /mcp or trailing slash. Replace localhost before connecting ChatGPT. / 部署后的 HTTPS 根地址，不能保留 localhost。

BRIDGE_TOKEN.description: Generate a unique secret with openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it private; do not use the example value. / 生成独立随机管理密钥，勿使用示例值。

EVENTS_DISCOVERY_ENABLED.description: Set true to expose message.created to ChatGPT; delivery still requires trusted CALLBACK_HOSTS. / 设为 true 开启事件发现。

CALLBACK_HOSTS.description: Exact trusted event callback hosts, comma-separated. The first ChatGPT test used connectors.api.openai.com; verify for your own client. No wildcards. / 核实后填写精确回调主机。

OAUTH_REDIRECT_URIS.description: Exact ChatGPT OAuth redirect URIs. Keep the stable default; add only a verified redirect from your own installation. / 保留稳定回调，只添加自身核验的 URI。

ACCOUNTS.description: Private Weixin binding, message queue and event subscriptions. Created in your account. / 独立微信绑定与消息存储。

OAUTH.description: Private OAuth grant and token-hash storage. Created in your account. / 独立 OAuth 授权存储。
